hero.title: Group vacations in Sri Lanka
hero.body: For eight or more people travelling together. Tell us who you are and why you are coming, and we look after everything around it: rooms, transport, guides and the moments that bring a group together.
hero.alt: Two travellers looking across the forest to Sigiriya rock at first light

intro.heading: Not a tour. A plan for your group.
paragraphs: A group vacation is not a fixed itinerary with a departure date. It starts with your group: who is coming, what you are celebrating or studying, and how you like to travel.
From there we put together the services you need and draw a route around them. You can take one service or all of them, and the quote shows each one.

types.heading: Five kinds of group we plan for.
types.body: Pick the closest, or tell us yours. Each one shows the services we usually bring together.

catalog.heading: Services, not a set menu.
catalog.body: Every group takes a different mix. These are the pieces we put together.

items.title: Trip design
items.body: A route drawn around your group, with drives short enough for everyone.

items.title: Rooms and villas
items.body: Room blocks, whole-villa buyouts and estate bungalows, with a rooming list we manage.

items.title: Group transport
items.body: Vans, mini coaches and coaches, each with its own driver.

items.title: A tour leader
items.body: A Travedise leader with the group, handling the day so you do not have to.

items.title: Activities and access
items.body: Guides, park permits, cooking classes, matches, workshops and early entry where we can get it.

items.title: Private events
items.body: Dinners on the beach or in Galle Fort, celebrations, blessings and gala nights.

items.title: Meeting spaces
items.body: For offsites and conferences, rooms with screens, sound and reliable internet.

items.title: Support on the trip
items.body: A coordinator on call throughout, for the changes that always come up.

items.title: Tell us about the group
items.body: Who is coming, roughly when, and what the trip is for.

items.title: A call within a few days
items.body: We ask the questions that shape the trip: ages, pace, budget, what matters most.

items.title: A plan and a quote
items.body: A route, the services, and a price per person with every part listed.

items.title: We look after it
items.body: Rooms, transport and every day of the trip, with one person to call.

questions.a: Eight travellers or more. For smaller parties, one of our journeys, tailored to you, usually works better.
No. We suggest shapes to start from, then draw the route around your group's dates, interests and pace.

questions.q: How is a group trip priced?
questions.a: Per person, after we understand the group. The quote lists each service, so you can add or remove parts and see the difference.

questions.q: Can people in the group pay separately?
questions.a: Yes. We can take payments from each traveller or family, so the organiser does not have to collect them.

questions.q: How far ahead should we plan?
questions.a: Two to four months for most groups. For large groups, December to March, or festival dates, start six months or more ahead.

form.heading: Tell us about your group.
form.body: Two short steps. We reply within a day to arrange a call.

stepOne.title: Tell us about the group.
stepOne.body: Rough numbers and dates are fine.

stepTwo.title: How can we reach you?
stepTwo.body: We will use these details to reply to this enquiry, nothing else.

sent.title: Thank you. We will be in touch within a day.
sent.body: Your enquiry is with us and a copy is on its way to your inbox. We will reply to set up a call.
